required_changes: Execute approved implementation-context T1-T5 and M1-01..07.
Preserve one RuntimeFacade submission lane and existing semantic/session/camera owners.
Implement actual common Tool/Options/View/State UI on Windows/Web/Android; publish runnable bundles.
Use per-session resolved options in preview, canonical capture and replay; preserve vector and dab behavior.
If M1 directly exercises an existing source-lifecycle defect within allowed paths, fix narrowly with regression evidence; do not claim unrelated Facade findings closed.
forbidden_changes: No M2 background schema/rendering, export or object-list feature.
No entire synchronization workflow, server/auth/Outbox/Inbox/WAL product or pre-G5 network extraction.
No canonical schema/Operation vocabulary or brush algorithm redesign.
No deep BrushAuthoring editor, TextEdit/IME or new public C ABI.
No edits to frozen package inputs, old task results or gates; no force-push/reset or integration into main.
No SDK lock changes or rebuilding locked Semantic/Skia dependencies.
implementation.scope_rule: Glob membership is necessary, not sufficient; only M1 changes and directly triggered correctness fixes are authorized. Report out-of-scope defects without silently fixing or hiding them.
